name: koalafix
description: Shared team memory for the AI tools your team uses: recall what the team already knows before acting, save notes and decisions, verify facts, and see who is working on what. One remote server at https://mcp.koalafix.com/mcp; you sign in in the browser the first time a tool is used. Nothing runs on your machine: no scripts, no hooks, no helper program. The automatic Claude Code hooks are in the marketplace plugin koalafix-auto.
